text: Added shared device-to-root event translation plus thin Canvas, Java2D, and JavaFX hosts. Each compiles the same ViewerFrame through the existing backend and emits pure Pick/Scroll actions; Java2D includes real BufferedImage rendering and JavaFX includes live GraphicsContext adaptation. Verified shared JVM+JS (17 each), Canvas JS (2), Java2D JVM (2), JavaFX JVM (2).
